a conflict from an insertion in the middle of the log, a second hunk, a second file, or another task\\u0027s placeholder is not the shape and parks exactly as today\u0022,\u0022On the shape the resolver writes ours followed by theirs, stages PLAN.md, and continues the rebase; because a rebase stops commit by commit, the shape check re-runs on every stop of the same rebase and the run parks the moment a stop is not the shape (the worktree restored to the pre-attempt tip as today); the existing renumber step then assigns the placeholder its real number; the outcome is recorded on the run\\u0027s rebase event as resolved mechanically, a third value distinct from a clean apply and from recovery by an agent session, and the log line names the shape and the entry numbers it kept\u0022,\u0022The stacked-child checkpoint replay\\u0027s conflict branch calls the same resolver when the shape matches and is otherwise unchanged; if the builder finds that path needs any logic of its own beyond calling the resolver, it is left out of this task and noted in the pull request as a follow-up\u0022,\u0022Unit tests over the resolver\\u0027s input (the conflicted file list and the conflict text, no git repository created) cover the exact shape, a two-entry ours, and near-misses that must still park: a conflict elsewhere in PLAN.md, a second conflicted file, a placeholder that is not this task\\u0027s own, a main-side hunk that is an incomplete or unnumbered entry, and a second stop of the same rebase that is a real conflict after the first stop was resolved;
